annotations.title: Look up Final POS REST API

description: Look up the Final POS REST API (https://api.finalpos.com) — endpoint method/path, request fields, response shape, and a worked fetch example. This is the ONLINE-ONLY fallback for admin/management operations command-frame cannot express (creating products/variants/categories, customer management, outlets/stations/tax tables, webhooks). Command-frame is ALWAYS first choice for live POS data — it works offline and the host owns money/totals. A call to this API is network egress from the station: it fails whenever connectivity does, so never put one in the sale path — use it for setup/admin work and degrade gracefully. Pass resource to list a domain, operation for one endpoint, or query for fuzzy search.
